_doc: Hand-maintained context for the console views. build_console.py copies it into data.json. coverage_marks: dated changes in HOW the tracker collects, drawn on the activity chart so a jump in collection is not read as a jump in regulation (add one whenever a source family starts, stops or is backfilled). matter_labels: short names for dockets and matters, keyed by the docket key the console extracts from the Document column. party_groups: watched parties that file under several names, folded into one row of the party view; party_kinds: the role each party plays.

coverage_marks.label: Baseline loaded
coverage_marks.detail: Everything dated before 18 Sep was collected retrospectively in one pass that followed known docket numbers; docket activity was never enumerated filing by filing.

coverage_marks.label: Two Mondays missed
coverage_marks.detail: The weekly tasks were disabled on 21 and 28 Sep; nothing was collected live until 3 Oct.

coverage_marks.label: Nightly collector starts
coverage_marks.detail: Commission portals, FERC, EDGAR, RTO pages and governors' newsrooms read every night from 2 Oct; docket-history backfill to 7 Nov 2025 dispatched 3 Oct.

jurisdiction_notes.AZ: Filing lists are read nightly; the documents themselves only through the manual pass (the ACC image host presents a certificate for another hostname).
jurisdiction_notes.TX: ERCOT notices and large-load status pages are read nightly as well as PUCT projects; executive actions arrive through the governor's newsroom.
jurisdiction_notes.PA: The commission refuses the collector, so the Monday Sweep reads it with the web reader.
jurisdiction_notes.NV: No text layer on PUCN documents, so Nevada rows are Reported at most.
jurisdiction_notes.OK: OCC page-text service errors; the Sweep confirms from the PDF text.
jurisdiction_notes.VA: Between manual passes: Dominion, ApCo and NOVEC disclosures on EDGAR, the DCC Bi-Weekly and trade mail.
jurisdiction_notes.NC: Between manual passes: NCUC main-site PDFs, NCUC mail and Duke on EDGAR.
jurisdiction_notes.SC: Between manual passes: PSC publications and ORS pages (collector) and Duke and Dominion on EDGAR.
jurisdiction_notes.IL: Between manual passes: ComEd and Exelon on EDGAR, the IPA site and trade mail.
jurisdiction_notes.OH: Between manual passes: Ohio Consumers' Counsel filings (collector), AEP Ohio on EDGAR and Columbus agendas.
jurisdiction_notes.WV: Between manual passes: ApCo and AEP on EDGAR and the governor's page.

matter_labels.26-0364: ICC investigation of ComEd large-load protections
